note: McNemar per seed pairing; there is no primary seed. Holm-Bonferroni is applied separately within each seed family (all pairs of one config and split under that seed; pairs of single-run models appear with their one run in every family). p_min / p_max are the smallest and largest raw McNemar p over the families; n_seeds_significant counts the families in which the Holm-adjusted p is below 0.05. Pairs: 45 on test; 55 on external (the 45 plus the 10 prosus_finbert pairs). The bootstrap is the seed+sentence two-level bootstrap of the Macro-F1 difference.
